newsitem.title: USA: Toreador Royalty reserves up 29.5 pct.
newsitem.headline: Toreador Royalty reserves up 29.5 pct.

text.p: Toreador Royalty Corp said its oil and natural gas reserves were 1,300,095 barrels of oil equivalents as of year end 1996, an increase of 29.5 percent during the year.

The company said oil reserves rose 39 percent to 791,272 barrels from 569,281 barrels at the end of 1995. For the same period, natural gas reserves increased by 17.1 percent, going from 2.607 billion cubic feet to 3.053 billion cubic feet.

The present value of Toreador reserves, pretax, discounted at 10 percent, rose 88.7 percent to $11.345 million. The increase reflects the growth in reserves as well as higher oil and natural gas prices at year end 1996.
